description: Checks uploaded hashes, screens the new bytes, and commits one version under the slug lock. Inputs: session (upl_...), optional expected_version, and token. A stale expected_version returns version_conflict and writes nothing. A bad hash returns hash_mismatch. An expired session returns session_expired.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: finalize_upload
title: Finalize a large upload
